verses.text: Of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.

xrefs.text: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, O my soul.
My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing and make music.
What then shall I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my mind. I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my mind.
God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.
Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

verses.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds—

xrefs.text: I will make known the LORD’s loving devotion and His praiseworthy acts, because of all that the LORD has done for us— the many good things for the house of Israel according to His great compassion and loving devotion.
How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?
Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
When one of them saw that he was healed, he came back, praising God in a loud voice.
be careful not to forget the LORD who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

verses.text: He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases,

xrefs.text: saying, “If you will listen carefully to the voice of the LORD your God, and do what is right in His eyes, and pay attention to His commands, and keep all His statutes, then I will not bring on you any of the diseases I inflicted on the Egyptians. For I am the LORD who heals you.”
But He was pierced for our transgressions, He was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was upon Him, and by His stripes we are healed.
Heal me, O LORD, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved, for You are my praise.
O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.
The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness.

verses.text: who redeems your life from the Pit and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion,

xrefs.text: For You have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.
As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
The LORD redeems His servants, and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned.
Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.

verses.text: who satisfies you with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

xrefs.text: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.
For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
Instruct those who are rich in the present age not to be conceited and not to put their hope in the uncertainty of wealth, but in God, who richly provides all things for us to enjoy.
Therefore we do not lose heart. Though our outer self is wasting away, yet our inner self is being renewed day by day.
My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.

verses.text: The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.

xrefs.text: “For the cause of the oppressed and for the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD. “I will bring safety to him who yearns.”
The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
Whoever oppresses the poor taunts their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honors Him.
He executes justice for the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets the prisoners free,
For he will deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper.

verses.text: He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the people of Israel.

xrefs.text: Now if indeed I have found favor in Your sight, please let me know Your ways, that I may know You and find favor in Your sight. Remember that this nation is Your people.”
He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel.
They forgot what He had done, the wonders He had shown them.
You revealed to them Your holy Sabbath and gave them commandments and statutes and laws through Your servant Moses.
You led Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

verses.text: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.

xrefs.text: But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.
So rend your hearts and not your garments, and return to the LORD your God. For He is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion. And He relents from sending disaster.
Then the LORD passed in front of Moses and called out: “The LORD, the LORD God, is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness,
The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion.
The LORD is slow to anger and great in power; the LORD will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. His path is in the whirlwind and storm, and clouds are the dust beneath His feet.

verses.text: He will not always accuse us, nor harbor His anger forever.

xrefs.text: For I will not accuse you forever, nor will I always be angry; for then the spirit of man would grow weak before Me— the breath of life I have made.
For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance— who does not retain His anger forever, because He delights in loving devotion?
Will He be angry forever? Will He be indignant to the end?’ This you have spoken, but you keep doing all the evil you can.”

Go, proclaim this message toward the north: ‘Return, O faithless Israel,’ declares the LORD. ‘I will no longer look on you with anger, for I am merciful,’ declares the LORD. ‘I will not be angry forever.

verses.text: He has not dealt with us according to our sins or repaid us according to our iniquities.

xrefs.text: After all that has come upon us because of our evil deeds and our great guilt (though You, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve and have given us such a remnant as this),
But in Your great compassion, You did not put an end to them; nor did You forsake them, for You are a gracious and compassionate God.
Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?

Incline Your ear, O my God, and hear; open Your eyes and see the desolation of the city that bears Your name. For we are not presenting our petitions before You because of our righteous acts, but because of Your great compassion.

verses.text: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.

xrefs.text: For Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens, and Your faithfulness to the clouds.
His mercy extends to those who fear Him, from generation to generation.
But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children—
But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,
Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.

verses.text: As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.

xrefs.text: I, yes I, am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake and remembers your sins no more.
But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance— who does not retain His anger forever, because He delights in loving devotion?
Surely for my own welfare I had such great anguish; but Your love has delivered me from the pit of oblivion, for You have cast all my sins behind Your back.

No longer will each man teach his neighbor or his brother, saying, ‘Know the LORD,’ because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest, declares the LORD. For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.”

verses.text: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.

xrefs.text: What father among you, if his son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?
The son declared, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.
And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not take lightly the discipline of the Lord, and do not lose heart when He rebukes you.
But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children—

Is not Ephraim a precious son to Me, a delightful child? Though I often speak against him, I still remember him. Therefore My heart yearns for him; I have great compassion for him,” declares the LORD.

verses.text: For He knows our frame; He is mindful that we are dust.

xrefs.text: before the dust returns to the ground from which it came and the spirit returns to God who gave it.
And yet He was compassionate; He forgave their iniquity and did not destroy them. He often restrained His anger and did not unleash His full wrath.
Please remember that You molded me like clay. Would You now return me to dust?
Remember the briefness of my lifespan! For what futility You have created all men!
By the sweat of your brow you will eat your bread, until you return to the ground— because out of it were you taken. For dust you are, and to dust you shall return.”

verses.text: As for man, his days are like grass— he blooms like a flower of the field;

xrefs.text: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,
But the one who is rich should exult in his low position, because he will pass away like a flower of the field.
A voice says, “Cry out!” And I asked, “What should I cry out?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field.
“I, even I, am He who comforts you. Why should you be afraid of mortal man, of a son of man who withers like grass?
Woe to the majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards, to the fading flower of his glorious splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, the pride of those overcome by wine.

verses.text: when the wind passes over, it vanishes, and its place remembers it no more.

xrefs.text: The grass withers and the flowers fall when the breath of the LORD blows on them; indeed, the people are grass.
The eye that saw him will see him no more, and his place will no longer behold him.
But a man dies and is laid low; he breathes his last, and where is he?
My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle; they come to an end without hope.
Enoch walked with God, and then he was no more, because God had taken him away.

verses.text: But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children—

xrefs.text: For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
He has saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works, but by His own purpose and by the grace He granted us in Christ Jesus before time began.
But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,
but showing loving devotion to a thousand generations of those who love Me and keep My commandments.
For the gospel reveals the righteousness of God that comes by faith from start to finish, just as it is written: “The righteous will live by faith.”

verses.text: to those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts.

xrefs.text: Know therefore that the LORD your God is God, the faithful God who keeps His covenant of loving devotion for a thousand generations of those who love Him and keep His commandments.
If your sons keep My covenant and the testimony I will teach them, then their sons will also sit on your throne forever and ever.”
and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.
Both of them were righteous in the sight of God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and decrees of the Lord.
So Moses took the blood, splattered it on the people, and said, “This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.”

verses.text: The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.

xrefs.text: How awesome is the LORD Most High, the great King over all the earth!
Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above all names,
But the LORD abides forever; He has established His throne for judgment.
who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God, with angels, authorities, and powers subject to Him.
The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD is on His heavenly throne. His eyes are watching closely; they examine the sons of men.

verses.text: Bless the LORD, all His angels mighty in strength who carry out His word, who hearken to the voice of His command.

xrefs.text: Are not the angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?
Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His heavenly hosts.
“I am Gabriel, replied the angel. “I stand in the presence of God, and I have been sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
Are you not aware that I can call on My Father, and He will at once put at My disposal more than twelve legions of angels?
And suddenly there appeared with the angel a great multitude of the heavenly host, praising God and saying:

verses.text: Bless the LORD, all His hosts, you servants who do His will.

xrefs.text: Micaiah continued, “Therefore hear the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on His throne, and all the host of heaven standing by Him on His right and on His left.

You alone are the LORD. You created the heavens, the highest heavens with all their host, the earth and all that is on it, the seas and all that is in them. You give life to all things, and the host of heaven worships You.
And suddenly there appeared with the angel a great multitude of the heavenly host, praising God and saying:
He makes the winds His messengers, flames of fire His servants.
Are not the angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?

verses.text: Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!

xrefs.text: Shout for joy, O heavens; rejoice, O earth; break forth in song, O mountains! For the LORD has comforted His people, and He will have compassion on His afflicted ones.
Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise from the ends of the earth— you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who dwell in them.
All You have made will give You thanks, O LORD, and Your saints will bless You.
Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Hallelujah!
Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all you shining stars.
